classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the arc length from the given radian angle and recognise that the full perimeter also includes both radii.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of the following sector.

spec.description: Unshaded sector opening upward, with a black centre dot, an upper circular arc, an interior angle mark labelled 3π/5 and a sloping lower-right radius labelled 4 cm.
spec.mathematics: Both straight edges are radii of length 4 cm. The included angle is 3π/5 radians, equivalent to 108 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Show only the supplied angle and radius. The arc length and perimeter remain unanswered.
